verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken banner layout. The price sits far left and its own qualifier 'for all drinkware on' sits far right, with the product list and stripe motif in between, so the message reads out of order. In both, the five-item list is tiny and the rotated URL is an illegible sliver. B is slightly worse because 'on' is orphaned alone on the second line; A breaks the qualifier evenly as 'for all / drinkware on'.
